tools.name: xenmark_whoami
tools.description: Identify the Xenmark account behind the configured token: user_id, display_name, company. Never returns e-mail, plan, billing or role.

tools.name: xenmark_recent_activity
tools.description: The user's Xenmark notification inbox, newest first: new comments, replies, mentions and status changes on drawings the user is part of. Each row has actor_name, project_name, drawing_number, revision_label, comment_number, title, preview, mention_labels, old_status/new_status (status changes), read, created_at and a web_url deep link into Xenmark. Use web_url for links - never build Xenmark URLs.

tools.name: xenmark_list_projects
tools.description: Projects the user owns or is a member of: id, name, description, company_name, status (active/archived), my_role, created_at, updated_at, web_url.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's next_cursor, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: xenmark_list_drawings
tools.description: Drawings in one project: id, drawing_number, name, revision_count, created_at, web_url. Needs the project id from xenmark_list_projects or xenmark_find_drawing.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's next_cursor, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: xenmark_list_revisions
tools.description: Revisions of one drawing: id, revision_label, original_filename, size_bytes, content_type, created_at, web_url. Files themselves are never available.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's next_cursor, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: xenmark_review_summary
tools.description: Comment-status rollup for one or more revisions (up to 100): total_comments, open_count, progress_count, closed_count, last_activity_at per revision. Revisions the user cannot access are silently omitted.

tools.name: xenmark_list_comments
tools.description: Comments on one revision: id, comment_number (quote this to people), title, description, status, author_display_name, page, reply_count, annotation_count, web_url, plus a replies_preview of up to 3 replies and replies_truncated.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's next_cursor, to fetch the next page.

include_replies_preview.description: Include up to 3 replies per comment (default true).

tools.name: xenmark_list_replies
tools.description: All replies on one comment, paginated: id, author_display_name, body, created_at, edited_at.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's next_cursor, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: xenmark_find_drawing
tools.description: Find drawings by drawing number or name fragment across the user's projects (or within one project) and return their ids, project, revision_count and web_url. Use this when the user names a drawing rather than an id. Walks at most 20 projects and says so if truncated.

query.description: Drawing number or part of the name, e.g. "1001-300".

project_id.description: Limit the search to one project.
